residual_risks: This is the smallest contract-compliant slice of LLD v1.1 section 3's normative 44-transition C6 workflow (ACT-T01..T31b) -- it exercises the representative Authority/Human Gate/Decision/EMISSION-FENCE path for a single successful and several denied actions, not the full FSM's retry, compensation, reconciliation or indeterminate-adjudication branches (ACT-T15..T28), which remain out of scope for this task.

ocor_runtime.c6_capabilities.CapabilityAuthority and ocor_runtime.c7_emission.EmissionFence were discovered already sealed from an earlier delivery phase (predating this session's backlog); both are reused completely unmodified. Approval and Decision are the only genuinely new record types this task adds, since no Human Gate or Decision record existed anywhere in the codebase before.

The simulated effect is a plain in-memory RecordingSink; no real external system is dispatched to, matching the acceptance criterion's own wording ('before a simulated effect') and this task's pure, in-memory, deterministic scope (no external backend needed, mirroring OCOR-DEV-0028's C1 compiler slice).

No AFF-002/AFF-006 concern applies: the new module imports zero direct backend clients (psycopg, kafka, qdrant_client, terminusdb_client, typedb) -- verified by re-running scripts/validate_rccad.py, all 10 fitness functions PASS_STATIC_PRECHECK.
The same pre-existing local-venv gap noted in prior evidence (uv cannot resolve the exact 3.12.11 interpreter in this sandbox) is unchanged and out of this task's scope.
rollback_procedure_verified: Every test constructs a fresh CapabilityAuthority/AtomicOutboxStore/EmissionFence per test (function-scoped fixtures), so no test leaves residual state another run could collide with.
